component.name: mcp-server-patreon
component.summary: MCP server for the Patreon API

description.p: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing the Patreon API v2 as tools for an LLM agent, built on fastmcp. It runs over stdio and is registered into a local mcprack catalog by its companion package.

Tools fetch the authenticated user's identity, the creator's campaigns with tiers, campaign members and posts, with cursor-based pagination. All tools are read-only. The access token is read from the environment and is never a tool parameter.
